steps.title: Prepare Sample Labels
steps.instruction: Print the required labels for Bray extraction for each site, depth, and replicate.

steps.title: Weigh Soil Samples
steps.instruction: Weigh out 2 g of soil into labeled 50 mL centrifuge tubes.

steps.title: Add Extraction Solution
steps.instruction: Add 14 mL of Bray Extract solution (located in cabinet under hood in 1521) using the pipet and electronic pipettor.

steps.title: Mix and Shake Samples
steps.instruction: Mix the samples and shake them at a specific speed and duration.

substeps.instruction: Cap the samples and shake to mix.
Place samples into a foam block on the shaker.
Shake samples at 1000 rpm for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Centrifuge Samples
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the samples using the centrifuge on the west side of 1521.

substeps.instruction: Set centrifuge to 4000 rpm for 8 minutes.

steps.title: Collect Supernatant
steps.instruction: Pour off the liquid into a clean and labelled 15 mL centrifuge tube.

steps.title: Store or Filter Extracts
steps.instruction: Either filter the extracts immediately or store them in the freezer.

substeps.instruction: If unable to filter immediately, freeze samples on their side to prevent tube breaking in the -20 °C freezer (Staging Freezer 2) bottom shelf.
Follow the sample filtering protocol when ready to filter extracts.
